scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names shared,web,api "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --kill-others --names shared,web "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@make-my-marriage/web && npm run build --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm exec --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api -- prisma migrate dev --config prisma7.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm exec --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api -- prisma migrate deploy --config prisma7.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:status: npm exec --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api -- prisma migrate status --config prisma7.config.ts
